disable_root.description: Disable direct root login via SSH and console. Strongly recommended in production.

preserve_hostname.description: Keep the OS hostname as-is and ignore the hostname provided by the cloud datasource.

manage_etc_hosts.description: Rewrite /etc/hosts on each boot so the instance hostname resolves to 127.0.1.1.

ssh_pwauth.description: Allow SSH password authentication. Set to false to enforce key-only access (recommended).

ssh_deletekeys.description: Delete any pre-baked SSH host keys from the image and regenerate them on first boot.

ssh_genkeytypes.description: SSH host key algorithms to generate on first boot.

locale.description: System locale (LANG). Must appear in /usr/share/i18n/SUPPORTED on the target image.

timezone.description: System timezone using tz database names, e.g. UTC, Europe/Berlin, America/New_York.

resize_rootfs.description: Expand the root filesystem to fill the partition after growpart widens it.

growpart_mode.description: Partition growth backend: auto (detect tool automatically), growpart, gpart, or off to disable.

package_upgrade.description: Run a full package upgrade on first boot. Increases boot time but ensures day-0 security patches.

packages.description: Extra packages to install during first boot via the distro package manager.

ntp_servers.description: NTP server hostnames or IPs. Use your cloud provider's internal endpoint (e.g. 169.254.169.123 on AWS) for lowest latency.

admin_user.description: Primary administrative user created on first boot. Also written into system_info.default_user.

groups.description: Supplementary Unix groups to add the user to (list of strings).

sudo.description: Sudoers rule, e.g. ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL. Empty string = no sudo access.

lock_passwd.description: Lock the Unix password slot to prevent password-based logins.

ssh_authorized_keys.description: Full SSH public key strings (e.g. ssh-ed25519 AAAA... user@host) to pre-authorize.

extra_users.description: Additional users to create beyond the primary admin user. Each entry has the same shape as admin_user.

shell.description: Default login shell path. Use /usr/sbin/nologin for service accounts.

sudo.description: Sudoers rule. Empty string = no sudo access.

ssh_authorized_keys.description: Pre-authorized SSH public keys (full key strings).

datasource_list.description: Cloud metadata datasources to probe in order. Restrict to your actual cloud provider to cut first-boot time. Common values: Ec2, Azure, GCE, OpenStack, NoCloud, None.

ec2_metadata_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the EC2 IMDSv2 token endpoint per connection attempt.

ec2_metadata_max_wait.description: Total seconds cloud-init will retry EC2 metadata fetching before giving up on the datasource.

distro.description: Distro identifier for package manager and convention selection. Typical values: ubuntu, debian, rhel, centos, sles.

ssh_svcname.description: systemd unit name for the SSH daemon. Use ssh on Debian/Ubuntu, sshd on RHEL/CentOS/Fedora.

final_message.description: Message logged to /var/log/cloud-init-output.log when all modules complete. Supported substitutions: $VERSION, $TIMESTAMP, $DATASOURCE, $UPTIME.
